name: v-extension-bs
description: Vue 3, Vite and Bootstrap Extension starter

scripts.build: cross-env NODE_ENV=production run-s clear build:web build:prepare build:prod
scripts.build:dev: tsup src/background/index.js src/content/index.js --format iife --out-dir extension/dev/dist --no-splitting --onSuccess 'esno scripts/mvsw-dev.js'
scripts.build:prod: tsup src/background/index.js src/content/index.js --minify --format iife --out-dir extension/prod/dist --no-splitting --onSuccess 'esno scripts/mvsw-prod.js'
